children: French private equity and investment firm Tikehau Capital
, which has €53.3 billion ($62 billion) of assets under management, on Wednesday named Piero Migliorini as its head of private equity Italy and Martino Mauroner as co-head of Italy.
• Migliorini joins Tikehau from Aurora Growth Capital.
has also expanded its presence in Italy, having opened an office in Milan this year.
• Earlier this month, Italian economy minister Giancarlo Giorgetti said the country's economy could grow by around 1% this year, which would be above the latest government estimate.
